purpose: Teach: 盛り込ん/伺う/留保/派生/量産/保留/激減/差し上げ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今回の社員向け施策、皆の声を、盛り込んだ内容に、しましょうね。
lines.en: Let's make sure this staff initiative reflects everyone's input.
lines.style: Light, purposeful opening. Collaborative tone—inviting agreement, not imposing. Steady pace. Slight warm inflection on the final 'ne,' like reaching out to include.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の声を、伺う機会、増やしてまいります、来期も。
lines.en: Yes. We'll increase opportunities to hear from our customers in the next term as well.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Measured cadence. Clear commitment without overstatement. Slight nod in the voice—professional but genuine agreement.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新規プロジェクト、しばらく、判断、留保しましょう、市場の動向、見つつ。
lines.en: On the new project—let's hold off on a decision for now while we keep an eye on how the market moves.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate pace. No rush. Contemplative tone—weighing options carefully. Slight pause before 'while we keep an eye'—showing the reasoning unfold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本流から派生した、別事業、独立採算で、進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're already moving forward with the separate venture that branched off from the main line, under its own P&L.
lines.style: Informative, calm. Steady delivery—showing momentum without urgency. Mild pride in the update. Professional clarity throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 量産前のテスト、しっかり、行いましょうね、品質、命だから。
lines.en: Let's run thorough testing before mass production—quality is everything here.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Slight emphasis on 'thorough.' Warm underlying conviction. The tone of someone who knows what matters. Closes on a note of quiet seriousness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議の議題、一件、保留にしておきます、もう少し、情報、必要です。
lines.en: Yes. I'll put that agenda item on hold for now—we need a bit more information first.
lines.style: Straightforward, responsive. Brisk but not clipped. Practical tone—no drama, just clear next steps. Slight courtesy in the pacing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本日の売上、激減してるね、雨の影響かしらね、店舗、心配だわ。
lines.en: Sales dropped pretty sharply today. I wonder if it's the rain affecting things. I'm worried about the stores.
lines.style: Concerned, searching. Gentle hesitation on 'I wonder if'—thinking out loud. Slight worry in the trailing voice. Personal care showing through the professional frame.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お祝いの花、お得意様に、差し上げました、創業記念日に、合わせて。
lines.en: Yes. We sent congratulatory flowers to our key customers to mark their founding anniversary.
lines.style: Warm, attentive detail. Gentle pride in the gesture. Even pacing—showing thoughtfulness in action. Closes with quiet satisfaction.
